claims.quote: In Bangladesh it's known from fast-flowing small streams in the Meghna, Feni and Karnafuli drainages, and in India from the upper Brahmaputra, Barak and Tista rivers.
In Bangladesh it's known from fast-flowing small streams in the Meghna, Feni and Karnafuli drainages, and in India from the upper Brahmaputra, Barak and Tista rivers.
There is also a record from the upper Kosi River, a tributary of the Ganges, in Nepal (Kullander et al., 2017).
Records from southern India and Sri Lanka refer to D. malabaricus and similar species.
